name: UDAY PRATAP SINGH PARIHAR
headline: FULL STACK WEB DEVELOPER | AI-POWERED PRODUCTS | AUTOMATION
summary: Full-stack developer focused on shipping production features and building efficient automation systems. Hands-on experience building LLM-powered products, developing agentic workflows, and reverse-engineering complex APIs to solve integration challenges. Comfortable with high-throughput systems and building reliable tools where documentation is limited. I enjoy digging into how systems work to deliver scalable, effective solutions.

experience.title: Founding Engineer

Designed and maintained responsive client and warehouse dashboards using modern frontend frameworks, ensuring high-performance and user-friendly interfaces.
Developed secure, scalable backend services and RESTful APIs to support core logistics workflows and system integrations.

experience.title: Software Engineer Intern
bullets: Delivered end-to-end product features for Tradyon's cross-platform AI chatbot (Next.js web + React Native app), building responsive user interfaces and integrating AI-powered features.

Enabled rich responses (text + charts/graphs) by wiring workflows into the app's existing data and services layer via RESTful APIs.
